name: Alva

skills.name: Laceration
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Nix Requiem
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius, consumes all Confectance Index, for each Confectance Index consumed, deals Freeze damage equivalent to 30% ATK and 1 Stability Damage to it

skills.name: Freezing Touch
skills.description: Increases Shield amount applied by allies by 30%. When allies gain a Shield, the Shield is converted into Brumal Barrier with the same Shield HP. At the end of the action, increases Confectance Index by 3 points and gains 1 stack of Battle Prep. After launching Interception, increases Confectance Index by 1 point

fortification.effect: Increases damage multiplier to 20% ATK. If Alva has 3 stacks of Battle Prep after skill usage, enters into Covering Mode for 3 rounds (Duration decreases at the end of the current round) and increases Confectance Index by 6 points

Increases damage multiplier to 40% ATK

After skill usage, increases Confectance Index by 1 point for all Freeze units (excluding self)

Increases Shield amount applied by allies by 50%

New effect is added for Brumal Barrier - When the holder deals Freeze damage, for every 1000 Shield HP held, increases CRIT DMG by 1%

Increases the conversion rate to Brumal Barrier dealt by Interception during Covering Mode by 30%

In Covering Mode, 20% of the damage dealt by Nix Requiem is converted into Brumal Barrier for all allies

Enhances the effects of Liquid N2 Fang - Increases damage multiplier to 60% of the Shield HP

Enhances the effects of Hypothermia - Increases Freeze damage received by 40%

Increases absorption amount of Brumal Barrier to 300% of Alva's initial attack

When the holder deals Freeze damage, for every 1000 Shield HP held, the damage increase and CRIT DMG increase bonus are doubled

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Snowfield Strider
keys.effect: When Hoarfrost is applied to enemies within a 4 tile radius of Liquid N2 Fang, generates Frost tiles within the area for 3 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Logistics Specialist
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, increases Confectance Index by 3 points and gains 3 stacks of Battle Prep

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Support Command
keys.effect: Decreases Stability damage received for allies with Brumal Barrier by 1 point

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Late Bloomer
keys.effect: For each stack of Battle Prep consumed, increases ATK for self by 3%, up to 18%

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Rise Anew
keys.effect: Nix Requiem: Before skill usage, dispels 2 buffs from the target

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Bonechill
keys.effect: Increases Stability damage taken by enemies within a 4 tile radius of Liquid N2 Fang by 2 points

keys.name: Common Key - Mind's Eye
keys.effect: ATK +5% / Increases Phase damage towards enemies with Shield by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Inheriting the name of the Alpha Wolf
keys.effect:
The effect of Shield applied by this unit is increased by 80%.
Brumal Barrier effect enchanced: When dealing Freeze damage, the Shield value required to increase the damage dealt and critical damage is reduced to 500.
When frendly unit has Brumal Barrier and deals Freeze damage, they ignore 15% of target's defence.
Liquid N2 Fang effect enchanced: When Alva attacks, the damage multiplier based on the accumulated Shield absorbtion is doubled.
